keySentence: Toad got into trouble because he never listened.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Toad was in prison now. He felt very sorry. He wished he had listened. Toad got into trouble because he never listened.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Toad sat alone in his cold, dark prison cell. He remembered how his friends had warned him many times. They told him to stop driving so fast and so recklessly. Toad got into trouble because he never listened to anyone. Now he had tears in his eyes and felt truly sorry. He promised himself he would change if he ever got out.
